values.note: $20 a night for every Appleton site on the booking site for 2027 (probed 2027-05-20 and 2027-07-13); the DNR's 2026 rates table also gives $20. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

values.note: The DNR page says 24 sites; the booking site maps 25 (A1-A25). Allowed equipment by site on the booking site: 3 to 30 ft, 11 to 35 ft, 9 to 40 ft, 2 to 45 ft.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/brighton ('The Appleton Lake rustic campground offers 24 sites surrounded by oaks') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Appleton map resources, allowedEquipment per site: largest class 'Trailer or RV up to 45'' on 2 sites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Two vault toilets and a hand pump for potable water. Within walking distance of the Appleton Lake boating access site (dirt with a concrete ramp); direct access to trails open to mountain biking.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/brighton ('There are two vault toilets and a hand pump for potable water. The campground is within walking distance to the Appleton Lake Boating Access Site and provides direct access to trails open to mountain biking'; 'Appleton Lake (dirt with concrete ramp)'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online at MiDNRReservations.com or call 800-447-2757. The booking site takes Appleton reservations April 1 - October 14 (the DNR table's reservation season); dates outside it show every site unbookable.

note: Rustic campground in Brighton Recreation Area near Appleton Lake, in an oak forest; one of the park's several campgrounds (the modern Bishop Lake campground and the Murray Lake rustic campground are separate). --Claude
